blurb: Guests ride on two 149-passenger catamaran-style vessels with air-conditioned interior and covered exterior seating. The ferry offers round-trip hop-on/hop-off tickets allowing exploration of Downtown Pensacola, Fort Pickens, and Pensacola Beach. Onboard amenities include restrooms and sales of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.
extraNote: Tickets are non-refundable unless cruise is canceled due to weather or maintenance · Tickets expire if not used by the scheduled date · All cruises require a minimum of 10 guests to run; if not met, option to reschedule or refund · Service may be interrupted or canceled due to inclement weather; refunds or reschedules offered · Pensacola (downtown) 750 S.
